create_draft.title: Winged Ankh Pendant Necklace in 925 Sterling Silver, Egyptian Key of Life
create_draft.description:
Eternal Guardian is a substantial 925 sterling silver winged ankh pendant necklace inspired by the Egyptian Key of Life. Broad feathered wings frame the central ankh, creating a sculptural statement piece with a balanced unisex profile.

The pendant measures approximately 45 x 46 mm (1.77 x 1.81 in) and weighs approximately 33 g, giving it a solid, noticeable presence. It is paired with a 2 mm wide, 60 cm (23.6 in) long 925 sterling silver chain.

PRODUCT DETAILS

- Name: Eternal Guardian
- Design: winged ankh / Egyptian Key of Life
- Pendant material: 925 sterling silver
- Chain material: 925 sterling silver
- Pendant size: approximately 45 x 46 mm (1.77 x 1.81 in)
- Pendant weight: approximately 33 g
- Chain width: approximately 2 mm
- Chain length: 60 cm (23.6 in)
- Style: statement, symbolic, Egyptian-inspired
- Fit: unisex; designed for men and women
- SKU: 246

The ankh is an ancient Egyptian symbol commonly associated with life. Here, the traditional form is surrounded by layered wings, giving the necklace a bold guardian-like silhouette without relying on supernatural or protective claims.

CARE

Store the necklace dry and separately when it is not being worn. Wipe it gently with a soft jewelry cloth after use. Sterling silver naturally develops patina over time; avoid harsh chemicals, chlorine, and abrasive cleaners.

Please review the measurements before ordering. The enlarged close-up photographs are intended to show the design details; the stated dimensions provide the most reliable guide to physical size.
